T006-C19.canonical_reference: For every implementation change, define behavior from canonical requirements and write a meaningful failing test BEFORE implementation. Record RED command, actual failure and unchanged baseline; implement the smallest complete behavior; record GREEN result; refactor without changing the contract and record relevant regression results. Use real database/program/provider boundaries for material races and financial/access effects. Tests cannot be weakened, deleted or replaced with mocks merely to obtain green. For existing verified behavior, run and record the baseline and add a failing test for each changed/missing behavior; do not fabricate a red result. For decisions/docs/UAT-only work, define expected acceptance results before execution, record why a coding cycle is not applicable, and validate the actual deliverable.
T006-C19.rationale: Independent review accepts documentation readiness only. Canonical feature implementation, feature executions and/or required approvals are absent; no criterion exclusion or full-task PASS is granted.
